answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The plume of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on time-locked work history, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The juniper holds work receipts rather than names, so the forge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
